title: Crypto.com, Novig sue Missouri over sports event contracts; Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood hold off

sources.summary: Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood and Underdog, which also received cease-and-desist orders, have not filed suits in Missouri, according to court records.

title: MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes

sources.summary: The rules proposed in August would see companies that exist mainly to hold investments as no longer eligible for index inclusion.

title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto

sources.summary: Patrick Witt announced his departure from the White House last week.
